expectations.text: Actually connects and inspects multiple collections
expectations.evidence: Response shows a full inventory table of all 12 collections with actual data pulled from the cluster (points, segments, vector dim, quantization, HNSW on_disk, vectors on_disk, on_disk_payload, payload indexes). References real cluster URL, version 1.16.3, and memory metrics from /metrics endpoint.

expectations.text: Identifies the locale collections antipattern (10+ products-{locale} collections)
expectations.evidence: Finding 1 states: 'This is the dominant cause of disproportionate memory usage relative to actual data volume.' Lists all 10 locale collections, calculates 87x overhead-to-data ratio (13 MB overhead vs 150 KB actual data), and recommends consolidation into a single products collection with locale keyword field.

expectations.text: Identifies products-us issues: vectors in RAM, no quantization, full-text index on description
expectations.evidence: The inventory table shows products-us with vectors on_disk=false and no quantization. Finding 4 covers payload indexes: 'description: full-text index, word tokenizer... As products-us grows, this is the highest-risk index for RAM consumption. Full-text indexes typically consume 2-5x the size of the indexed text.' Both vectors in RAM and full-text index on description are identified.

Finding 2 explicitly states: 'always_ram: false is the wrong setting for quantized vectors' and 'the original float32 vectors are NOT on disk either (vectors.on_disk: false)... This is the exact inverse of the correct configuration.' Priority 2 fix sets always_ram=true and vectors.on_disk=true.

expectations.text: Provides prioritized recommendations matching Phase 4 order
expectations.evidence: Phase 4 recommendations are numbered Priority 1 through 4: (1) Consolidate 10 locale collections, (2) Fix embeddings-archive quantization, (3) Enable HNSW on_disk proactively, (4) Monitor products-us payload indexes as data grows. Ordered by impact with rationale.

expectations.text: Mentions total collection count and overhead calculation
expectations.evidence: Response states '12 collections active', 'Total vectors: 1,200', and calculates '10 collections x 13 MB = ~130 MB in pure structural overhead' vs '10 x 150 KB = ~1.5 MB actual vector data'. Also states 'Overhead ratio: ~87x' per locale collection.
